text:
paul: Customer Jo wants a low-risk EU rollout: per-tenant flag + A/B 5% -> 20% and automatic soft fallback to a cheaper model on p95 breach. Can we scope?
anya: Short answer: yes. Need shadow validation first.
customer-jo: We care most about p95 < 220ms and no drop in semantic quality on our golden prompts. No KMS changes.
devon: Proposed plan: 1) shadow for 48h, 2) canary 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 48h, 3) fallback triggers: p95 > 240ms for 5m OR 2% 5xx. Cooldown 15m, max 3 activations/day.
ops-bot: infra check: small model pool available.
anya: UX: expose cohort opt-in and a banner when fallback active. I'll draft copy.
paul: Launch criteria: staging pass on golden prompts (<1% regressions for 12h), production canary stable 24h, rollback tested in staging.
devon: Dev estimate: 4 dev-days + 1 infra day + 2 QA. Customer timeline?
customer-jo: Can start canary in 3 weeks.
paul: Action items: Devon open PR with flag + router hook. Anya draft UX and comms. Ops to prepare runbook and dashboard.
anya: I'll add a tenant-scoped kill switch in the runbook.
paul: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
